title: Trouble No. 2    Shift point too high or too low

Trouble No. 2    Shift point too high or too low

Warm up engine
Coolant temp.: 80°C (176°F)
ATF temp.:    50 – 80°C (122 – 176°F)

|
↓

Connect a voltmeter to check connector
terminals T↑ and E₁.
Does T↑ terminal voltage vary with changes
in throttle opening?
